text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I brought Royce and Royce, who hasn't been doing well lately, to pray at the shrine――

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"You gotta try everything you can!
Now then, let's offer a proper prayer and get ourselves a heap of blessings—wait, huh?"

W-Waaaaah!
It's all over, we're dooone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by the loud voice, I rushed over
to find a despairing Winning Ticket
and Nice Nature trying to soothe her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Royce and Trainer!
Great timing, help me back them up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seems like her fortune slip was really bad.
By the time I got here, she was already like this—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaahh, but it's Great Curse, you know!?
That's literally the worst one!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that might not necessarily be the case.
Drawing a rare result like 'Great Curse' would be a waste if you don't make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Take this "Person awaited will not come" fortune, for instance.
It could mean that rather than waiting for your destined one,
you should carve out your future with your own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
See? When you think about it like that, doesn't everything written here
start looking like advice
on how you should act?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true! "Discard extraneous thoughts"
could be read as "act rather than think"!
You're amazing, Royce!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So, what brings you here, Nature-san?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, I've just been feeling off lately.
Figured I'd pray for some divine help before it messes with my races, you know?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's why you picked this shrine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you came here without knowing?
The deity enshrined here is a god of war who governs victory.
It enshrines weapons and armor with which the god won a hundred battles.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Seeking to share in the good fortune of that undefeated strength,
not just Umamusume, but many athletes
come to visit and pray here!
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about this.
You sure know a lot about this.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Doing this much research is a given.
Going to pray for victory to a god of love would just cause them trouble, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I research. The shrine's origins, proper etiquette,
what brings joy, and even what is taboo."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I have to research everything thoroughly so I don't offend them at all. If you're gonna ask for something, you gotta make the gods actually want to grant it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Royce is kind of... —No, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Manners are important, right?
Since we're the ones asking, we have to make sure we know the proper etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to pray properly this time too!
Royce, can you teach me the official etiquette?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Let's all make our prayers properly and
rake in heaps of divine blessings!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pat, pat)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, lastly let's buy this shrine's main attraction,
a 'Certain Victory' amulet, before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Since we visited the shrine and prayed so flawlessly,
there's no doubt the divine blessings will be extraordinary—!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I got my amulet without any trouble,
so that was a flawless shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "My body feels a bit lighter too, so I guess my appeal to the gods was a total success♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a result of her earnest prayers,
Royce and Royce made a splendid recovery.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, oh no...
To think the charms are sold out...
choice_data_list: H-How about a charm for family safety instead?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume, Trainer!
"Absolute Victory"!
That's the only thing I desire!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Falling short at the very last moment,
Royce and Royce's slump continued."
